d:
Bihar, jharkhand aur purvi uttar pradesh ke kaee ilakon men dhumdham se chhath manaya jata hai. bihar ki rajdhani patna men rahne vale sikh samuday ke kaee log bhi is parv ko shraddha ke sath manate hai. is riport men dekhie kaise patna men sikh samuday ke log is parv ki taiyari karte hain.
Riport: situ tivari
Shut-edit: shahanvaz ahmad
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
(kripya not karen: naya aip briten aur amerika men uplabdh nahin hai.)
